text: Coffee with Natasha and Salma. Natasha's driving test is next Tuesday, third attempt, and she's properly nervous. Salma has gone vegan since the summer, so no more cheese boards. Text Natasha good luck the night before.

Long catch-up with Kieran after his gig on Friday. Band played the Lexington, sold out apparently. His girlfriend Anika is coeliac, which I'd completely forgotten. They're both off to Lisbon in a fortnight. Kieran said the drummer might be leaving the band after Christmas, which he's quite cut up about. Ask him about the Lisbon trip when they're back.

Erin's recital got called off, the hall flooded. She's gutted but says they'll reschedule for spring. Her mum drove down for it anyway so they just went for dinner. Erin drinks oat flat whites, never dairy.
Spoke to Andile on the phone. His son sits his grade 5 piano exam this Saturday and Andile is more stressed than the kid. Ask him how it went on Sunday. He's also off red meat for Lent, sort of.

Uma got her A level results back, AAB, so she's into Leeds for medicine. Her brother Santiago is starting his GCSEs this year. Their dad's doing a barbecue to celebrate this weekend. I'm bringing the halloumi. Uma's moving into halls the Sunday after, and she's already worried about cooking for herself, she can barely boil pasta.

Jin ran the half marathon yesterday, 1:52, a PB. Legs destroyed. He said the next day he couldn't walk downstairs. Kalani was at the finish line with their dog Biscuit. Don't forget to send Jin the photos I took.
Saanvi - allergic to tree nuts, carries an EpiPen. Mihai hates coriander. Both fine with spicy. Keep in mind for the dinner on the 14th.
Gareth's audition for the Royal Welsh is next Thursday. He's been practising eight hours a day and isn't sleeping. Must ring him the evening before.

Caught up with Gintaras at the pub. He only drinks Guinness or sparkling water now, nothing in between. His daughter has a gymnastics competition in Birmingham on Saturday and the whole family is driving up that morning. He also mentioned his knee is playing up again after football.

Yosef and Reza came round for food. Yosef keeps kosher, so I need to check the gelatine in the dessert next time. Reza's theory test is tomorrow and he hasn't revised. Remind me to message him afterwards to see if he passed.

Laura said Pieter's band is playing the Forum the week after next. She's already got tickets for us both. Pieter is apparently a nervous wreck before every show. Laura's off sugar till Christmas. She also said Pieter's mum is coming over from Utrecht for the show and staying the whole week. Pieter's mum is a big fan of stroopwafels, apparently. I should text Pieter good luck that afternoon.
Dafydd failed his driving test again this morning, clipped a kerb on the roundabout. He's booked another for a month from now. Feeling pretty low about it. Should take him for a pint at the weekend.
Picked up the cake for Saturday. Still need candles and napkins.
Aidan's partner Chantal is pregnant, due in March! He told me after five a side. Chantal's off coffee completely and craving pickled onions. Get them a card.
Sam's mock exams start Monday. His mum says he's barely sleeping and stress-eating crisps. I offered to help him with maths on Wednesday evening.
James and Nikolai's pub quiz team won the league final on Thursday. Nikolai's buying the first round next time apparently. James is lactose intolerant btw, explains the black coffee.

Phone call with Ahmed. His sister Rin passed her bar exam! Results came out yesterday. The family are having a dinner for her on Sunday and I'm invited. Ahmed says she loves anything with matcha, so maybe matcha chocolates as a gift.
Haruto has a judo grading the day after his birthday, poor timing. He's a black belt candidate. He's been on a strict diet, no rice after 6pm. Joe is going to drive him there.
Omar told me his dad's hip surgery went fine yesterday. He's staying with his parents until the end of the week. Omar doesn't drink at all, so no wine as a thank you, maybe dates.
Natasha passed!! Driving test done, zero minors. She's buying a little Fiat next week.
Need to book my own eye test before the end of the month. Also cancel the gym.

Amy's netball team made the county final, it's next Saturday at 2. She's captain this year. Her husband Kieran is doing the oranges at half time, his idea of support. Amy is gluten free so remember that for the team curry afterwards.

Uma Nakamura from work told me her violin recital is on Friday at St Martin's. She sounded nervous, first solo. I'm going with Erin. Afterwards maybe drinks at the Crown. Erin can't do the Crown though, she's teetotal and says their soft drinks are rubbish, so maybe the wine bar instead. Uma's parents are flying in from Osaka the day before the recital to watch her.
Kalani says Salma's birthday drinks are off, Salma's got flu. They'll do something the weekend after instead. Salma's into natural wine at the moment, could get a bottle for her.
Andile's wife Laura is running the London marathon in April for a cancer charity. Sponsor her. She's been training since January and is apparently obsessed with flapjacks now.
Mihai got his university offer through - Edinburgh, engineering. His mum cried. He wants a decent calculator, the fancy graphing one, which could be a nice present for when he leaves in September.

Chantal's play opens on Thursday at the Arts Centre, she plays Lady Macbeth. Opening night she'll be terrified, she always is. Tickets for Saturday's show booked for me and Gareth. Send her flowers that afternoon.
Spoke to Santiago, he's doing Dry January again plus no caffeine. Doubt it'll last. His brother-in-law Pieter supports Ajax and they're watching the match together Tuesday.
Reza did pass his theory, surprisingly. Practical is in six weeks. Yosef says he's already looking at cars.

Long chat with Anika. Her grandad died last week, funeral is on Monday. She's not doing great, hardly eating. Her flatmate Saanvi is looking after her. Check in with Anika on Tuesday, the day after. Saanvi said Anika keeps asking for her grandad's dal recipe, so maybe I could find one and cook it for her. Her family are all flying in from Pune for the funeral.
Gintaras is vegetarian now?? Since when. Also his son Joe got into the county under-14s squad, first match Sunday.
Erin and Dafydd are having a little engagement do on Saturday 12th at the Plough. Erin's only drinking prosecco, Dafydd's doing the beer. Bring something small, they said no presents but still.
Kieran's results day is Thursday. He wants to do sport science at Loughborough and needs BBB. Text him that morning.
Grandma's 90th next month. Order the photo book by Friday.
Nikolai Costa, the chef from the market, does a mean borscht. Hates mushrooms, oddly. Opening a stall in Peckham in the spring.
Rin's piano recital is on Saturday at 7. Her teacher thinks she could get a scholarship off the back of it. Rin hates being asked about it beforehand, so don't. Ask her how it went the next day.

Joe's darts final is tomorrow night. He's weirdly calm about it. Ahmed's driving us there, and Omar's coming if his shift finishes early. Joe only drinks shandy before matches, says it steadies his hand. If he wins he goes through to the regional finals in Blackpool in a fortnight. His wife is not thrilled about another weekend away.
Saanvi's son failed his eleven plus. Saanvi is devastated, he's fine. They're looking at other schools now.
Amy said Jin's allergic to shellfish, proper hospital-level allergic. And Jin's girlfriend Kalani won't eat anything spicy. Remember for the curry night on Friday.

Met Gareth's new girlfriend, Natasha. Lovely. She's a primary teacher and does triathlons. They're both doing the Cardiff 10k in a fortnight. Gareth only eats plain pasta the night before a race, which Natasha finds hilarious. Should go cheer them on at the finish.

Pieter's driving test was cancelled by the examiner, sick apparently. Rebooked for the 30th. He's annoyed because he'd taken the day off. His sister Laura is lending him her car for practice in the meantime.
Note to self: Aidan likes Lagavulin, Chantal prefers gin and elderflower.
Haruto Shah texted, his cat Miso has a dental op on Friday. He's anxious about the anaesthetic. Message him Friday afternoon to see how she got on.

Called Uma. Her daughter Salma's ballet exam was on Saturday, they get results in three weeks. Uma said Salma was shaking that morning but held it together. Uma's on the keto diet again, says it's going fine.

James had his MOT and also his citizenship test on the same day yesterday, passed both! He's celebrating with a curry tomorrow. He's not really drinking at the moment, so I'll order him a mango lassi.
Nobody worth noting today, just quiet. Bought new running shoes.

Omar's daughter is in the school play next Wednesday, she's a tree. He's taking half a day off. Their whole family is going, even his in-laws from Bradford. Omar said afterwards they'll go for pizza, his daughter only eats margherita.

Andile, Mihai and me did the quiz at the Lamb. Came second. Mihai mentioned he's sitting his ACCA exams in early December and is worried about the tax paper. Andile told me his wife's expecting their second in May. Andile's switched to alcohol free beer in solidarity. Remind me to drop Mihai a good luck text the day before the first exam, and to get something for Andile's baby before May.
Dafydd's mum is in hospital with pneumonia. He's been driving up every evening after work and is exhausted. Call him at the weekend.
Kalani won her age group in the sea swim on Sunday! Third year running. She said the water was 12 degrees. Celebrating with fish and chips, her favourite.

Talked to Ahmed about his brother Omar's audition for drama school, it's in a fortnight in London. Omar's practising monologues daily. Ahmed says he'll be fine but Omar's convinced he'll freeze. Good luck message the morning of.
Santiago and his wife Chantal Baker have split up. He's moved back to his mum's. He seemed okay but said he can't face cooking, living on toast. Invite him round for dinner next week.
Yosef mentioned his uncle Reza is retiring Friday after forty years as a bus driver. Big do at the depot afterwards. Yosef's making the cake, a lemon drizzle because Reza doesn't like chocolate.
Laura Williams from book club - can't do dairy, loves dark chocolate. Her twins have a swimming gala Saturday.

Bumped into Rin and Haruto at the farmers market. Rin's teaching a sushi class now, Thursdays. Haruto's football team got knocked out of the cup on Saturday, he's sulking. They've got a new puppy, a shiba called Kumo. Rin says Kumo chewed through Haruto's football boots the day before the match, which might explain the result. Haruto is also lactose intolerant, which is why he skipped the cheese stall.
Jin's daughter has her grade 3 violin exam in two weeks. Jin says she cries every time she practises scales. Ask Jin how it went the day after.
Kieran called off the boys' trip to Dublin, too many people dropped out. Doing a curry in town on the 22nd instead. Aidan's vegan now so it'll need to be somewhere decent.
Amy's son Sam got his black belt in karate yesterday! Took him four years. She's throwing a small party for him Sunday afternoon. He loves Lego so a set would be ideal.

Erin said her driving test is next Friday and then the following Monday she has a job interview at the vets. Big week. She's surviving on energy drinks, which isn't great. She seemed calm about the interview but terrified about the test. Text her on Thursday night and again Monday morning.
Gareth Olsen's band won the battle of the bands last night! They get to record an EP. Gareth's girlfriend Uma says the after party went on till 4. Send congrats.
